hero.h1: Toilet Repair and Installation in Geneva, IL
hero.sub: A toilet that runs all night, rocks on an old floor or clogs every week. We repair and replace toilets across Geneva, from historic bathrooms to new ones, with a flat price you approve first. From our office on Campbell Street.

blocks.h2: Toilet Problems We Fix in Geneva

tiles.body: A worn flapper or fill valve lets water trickle into the bowl around the clock.
A loose or broken flange, common on old floors that have shifted over the years.
A failed wax ring. In older homes, it can stain the ceiling below.
An early low-flow model, or a partly blocked line from roots in old clay pipe.

blocks.intro: Toilet repairs in Geneva often depend on the age of the floor underneath.

items.body: In historic homes, the flange may be cast iron or lead, and the floor may have shifted over a century. We repair the flange and level the toilet properly.
Older bathrooms sometimes have toilets set at non-standard distances from the wall. We measure before you buy.
If the toilet gurgles when other drains run, the main line may be partly blocked, often by roots in older neighborhoods. See [drain cleaning](/geneva/drain-cleaning).

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

steps.body: A fill valve costs far less than a toilet.
Old toilet hauled away if replaced.

items.preview: The flange or floor under it has shifted or broken.
items.answer: A loose or broken flange, or a floor that's shifted, lets the toilet move. Rocking breaks the seal and causes leaks, so it's worth fixing early.

items.q: Can you install a toilet in an old bathroom with an odd rough-in?
items.preview: Yes. We'll find one that fits.
items.answer: Yes. We measure the rough-in and help you choose a toilet made for that distance.

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.preview: The flapper or fill valve isn't sealing.
items.answer: Usually a worn flapper or fill valve. Replacing them is quick and inexpensive.

items.q: Should I replace an old toilet?
items.preview: If it's cracked, clogs often or uses a lot of water.
items.answer: Yes, if it's cracked, clogs often or is an older high-water model. Running and minor leaks are usually repairs.

items.q: Can you install a new toilet on an old floor?
items.preview: Yes. We level it and repair the flange as needed.
items.answer: Yes. On older floors that aren't level, we repair or replace the flange and shim the toilet so it sits solid and seals properly.

items.q: How much does toilet repair cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on the toilet and flange. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the toilet, whether the flange or shutoff needs work and removal of the old one. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
